newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba sets next two repo tenders at fixed 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba sets next two repo tenders at fixed 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday that it would keep its main money market rate, the repo, unchanged by setting its next two securities repurchase tenders at a fixed three percent rate.
Money market dealers had expected the move, which came at the same time the central bank also kept its discount and Lombard rates unchanged at 2.50 and 4.50 percent respectively.
The three percent rate has prevailed since August.
